cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the laptop shut, please. I haven't booked our anniversary trip, and searching flights before hearing me would be a mistake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought you just needed help finding cheap seats.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I let you think that. Please don't solve the price; I was relieved when the cheap seats sold out. Can you listen to the rest?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Is it the trip you don't want, or us?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Us. I'm not sure I want to stay together. Don't offer a different destination, please. Sit beside me while I try to say this properly.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1/A3 correct premature problem-solving and A5 directs how B should receive a harder admission.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's flight assumption is admitted as encouraged; B4 asks the real issue and A5 answers with relationship doubt.

relationship.evidence: B4 agrees to listen and asks a consequential question instead of adding conflict.

heightening.evidence: A5 moves from relief at failed logistics to doubt about staying together, then tests continued presence.

specificity.evidence: A1 gives an anniversary trip and unopened laptop; A3 supplies the missed cheap seats.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's destination correction protects the admission from being converted into travel planning.
